verdict_reason: It correctly asserts that the API refuses with a 400 validation problem, the only finding is a Minor one (it parses the body before checking the status, so an unexpected 5xx fails as a JSON parse error).

todos.issue: expectedApiRefusalOf runs JSON.parse(error.responseBody) at line 16, before expectedValidationRefusalOf checks the status at line 21. When the API returns a 5xx or a gateway 404 with an HTML or empty body, the test fails with a JSON SyntaxError, and the status and the RestClientError message (method, url, status) never reach the report. The inner helper also has one caller and types every refusal as a ValidationProblem, which goes beyond what its name claims ('Api refusal').
todos.fix: Must: when the API answers with something other than a 400 validation problem, the failure shows the status and the response body, not a parse error. One way: fold the two functions into expectedValidationRefusalOf, assert status 400 before parsing, and parse only after that assertion passes.
